user_review.method: Maintainer walked the new-user pin, export and recovery paths. Executed bundled helpers on a reviewed public-recording manifest and ran isolated negative and backward-compatibility cases. No destination account write or ChatGPT Web installation is asserted.

scenarios.request: Prepare about an hour of exact YouTube recordings before saving.
scenarios.expected: Pin the ordered recording IDs, compare a complete seconds total to the requested window, and produce an ordered link export.
scenarios.observed: A 15-recording manifest pinned and exported all 15 exact URLs in order. Its 3638 seconds passed the inclusive 58–62 minute window.

scenarios.request: Recheck the catalog after a verified recording was switched or its duration was edited.
scenarios.expected: Reject the change to sealed destination evidence before catalog probing while leaving the original independent catalog check intact.
scenarios.observed: Regression tests rejected edited IDs, order, or duration. Unchanged YouTube evidence survived canonicalization and timed boundary cases. Legacy catalog exports still work without claiming a verified destination.

similar_skills.learned: Review distinguishes resolved matches from local playlist changes; its default append skips existing items and replace rebuilds the list.
similar_skills.reason: Keep the match and destination evidence distinct. Preserve ordered repeats and reject wholesale replacement as a default.

similar_skills.learned: Preparation, matching, dry-run validation, and account creation are distinct checkpoints.
similar_skills.reason: Require per-recording pinning as a preflight and keep exact destination proof separate from catalog normalization. Do not assume account authorization.

validation.observed: 28 passed, including exact-ID tampering, seconds changes, duration boundaries and compatibility.
15 exact IDs pinned; 3638 seconds. An independent URL export contained all 15.
